sources.title: GitHub - enactic/openarm: A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical ...
sources.snippet: OpenArm is an open-source 7DOF humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments. With high backdrivability and compliance, it is built with safe human-robot interaction in mind while delivering practical payload capabilities for real-world applications.

sources.title: OpenArm
sources.snippet: A reproducible evaluation cell that standardizes background, lighting, cameras, and arm position for fair, automated AI model comparison. "Model A outperforms Model B" only holds meaning when evaluated under identical conditions — OpenArm Cell provides the reproducible infrastructure to make such claims verifiable.
